The full source of the pulse workspace. Every file here exists in the capstone/ directory of this repo.

Workspace

crates/domain — types and rules, no I/O

crates/api — the server

Note on the demo numbers: mrr_change_pct, active_users and churn_pct are hard-coded in this skeleton so the dashboard has something to render before you have historical data. The exercises ask you to compute them properly from a metrics_daily table.

crates/worker — rollups and jobs

Verifying it

Gotcha: the sha256 above must match hash_key() — the same bytes, the same encoding. encode(sha256($1::bytea), 'hex') produces lowercase hex, which is what hex::encode produces. A mismatch gives you a 401 you will spend an hour on.

Exercises

  1. Implement metrics_daily and compute mrr_change_pct, active_users and churn_pct from real data instead of the hard-coded values.
  2. Add POST /v1/invoices/{id}/pay and make it idempotent.
  3. Add pagination to /v1/invoices with keyset pagination.
  4. Add a usage_daily backfill command that rolls up the last 90 days.
  5. Write an integration test with sqlx::test covering ingest → dashboard.
  6. Add a request-id middleware that puts x-request-id into every log line.

Next: The dashboard frontend
